claim_text: A fragment in which he says he is in Europe and cannot see or say more.
quote: I'm in Europe, I see. I'm not I can't I'm not
falsify_match: Not applicable; nothing is given.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it records another point where he stops rather than continues.

claim_text: Iran ending abruptly rather than in retreat, with a group of key leaders dying in another round of strategic takeouts rather than negotiating, Mossad and Israel and boats seen, and the leaders falling like dominoes into pits with rest in peace written in English on tombstones.
quote: these leaders will fall like dominoes
falsify_match: A further round of Israeli decapitation strikes on Iranian leadership.
falsify_miss: No further round. Rest in peace written in English on Iranian graves is a detail that would not appear in Persian practice.

claim_text: The same passage repeated with one more round heard again and the leaders in the pits.
quote: One more round you'll hear
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; repetition within the stream.

claim_text: One more round of elimination and then an abrupt start, with the grey haired bald man named as Reza, a great revival stirring in the hearts of the Iranian people, and an uprising inside the land with things burned and the IRGC named.
quote: I see the man with the gray hair with the bald head, Rez
falsify_match: A popular uprising in Iran followed by Reza Pahlavi taking a role.
falsify_miss: No uprising. Naming the IRGC as the target of the uprising is the specific part.

claim_text: He is told it will not be allowed to go all the way because of Ezekiel 38 and 39, with people in the mountain and the bunkers, and falling stars seen that are missiles bombarding Iran.
quote: IT WILL NOT ALLOW HIM TO eliminate all the way
falsify_match: An Iranian campaign stopping short of regime destruction because of a later coalition war.
falsify_miss: Not distinguishable. The Ezekiel requirement means Iran must survive, which is used to explain any incomplete outcome.

claim_text: He is told to speed up and deal with Cuba, that it will be eliminated in a day, that it will never be all done because of Ezekiel 38 and 39 but it gives enough for the revival and freedom, with the island burning and oil barrels on fire.
quote: it's going to eliminate them in a day
falsify_match: Cuban government collapse within a day, with fires on the island.
falsify_miss: No collapse. The single day bound is repeated here, which makes it a settled part of the claim.

claim_text: Turkey rising and Ezekiel 38 and 39 said to be very close, repeated three times.
quote: You don't realize how close Ezekiel 38 and 39 are
falsify_match: Turkey moving militarily against Israel.
falsify_miss: It does not. Close carries no date and has been said repeatedly since 2025.

claim_text: Turkey beating war drums with war rhetoric to be listened for, controlling their waterways, seeking global dominance and going with Russia.
quote: They will beat their drums and they will even control their waterways
falsify_match: Turkey closing the straits or aligning openly with Russia against NATO.
falsify_miss: Turkey stays in NATO. Control of the waterways is the checkable part, since the Montreux Convention already gives it that role.

claim_text: The hook in the jaw heard with North Korea and Kim seen concerning Russia, and then suddenly gardens and food in America.
quote: As I hear hook in the jaw, I see North Korea
falsify_match: North Korea joining a coalition war on Israel.
falsify_miss: It does not. The abrupt switch to gardens is the point where the vision changes subject.

claim_text: A shaking in the Middle East that will shake Africa, South America and America, with people saying the finds are fake or AI before they are passed around and displayed in museums including in England, where there will be a great uprising.
quote: they'll be on display at certain places
falsify_match: An archaeological find exhibited internationally and disputed as fake.
falsify_miss: No such find. This connects the ark and tablets material to the museums, which is the next step he expects.

claim_text: Signs throughout Asia and South America with church becoming fun again, youth rallies with white shirts seen again with Erica, and a man coming up beside her.
quote: I see the youth rallies with the white shirts again
falsify_match: Youth rallies at scale associated with that named person.
falsify_miss: None. The man beside her recurs from the earlier telling, which makes the pairing stable.

claim_text: He summarises that the thing in Iran will never be ended, that more leaders will be eliminated, that the grey headed man and troops on the ground were seen, and that people rose up against the armed men, with a window and revival.
quote: I saw the thing in Iran would never be ended
falsify_match: A continuing Iranian conflict with popular resistance to the security forces.
falsify_miss: The conflict ends cleanly. Never ended is unfalsifiable as stated.

claim_text: He says Ezekiel 38 and 39 is about to take place with instruction to watch Turkey and Russia, and mentions Dracula, saying he told viewers the man would be like that.
quote: Ezekiel 38 and 39 is about to take place
falsify_match: The coalition war beginning.
falsify_miss: It does not. About to take place has been said since 2025 without a date.

claim_text: He describes praying over the previous heavy video most of the night and the assignment to keep praying for America, the president and other nations including Canada, calling it a never-ending deal.
quote: we'll continue to pray over it today
falsify_match: Not applicable; an account of the assignment.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Revival to be brought to Minnesota and Tennessee with Mobile named and John Kilpatrick used again, and prayer that these generals be strong like Moses, that their blood be good and that they live long and finish strong.
quote: I want to use John Kilpatrick again
falsify_match: Revival at the named ministries with those men leading it.
falsify_miss: None. Naming living ministers and their locations makes this checkable, unlike the general revival material.

claim_text: Azusa Street recalled with Seymour sitting with a box over his head, and Nash praying behind Finney for the great awakening, with the point that the hidden praying person is what it takes and that God will do a great awakening.
quote: I'm going to do a great awakening
falsify_match: A national awakening on the historical scale invoked.
falsify_miss: None. The Azusa and Finney comparisons set benchmarks that would be visible if met.

claim_text: He rebukes viewers who took the Boston and New York teams as a betting tip, says he was told to pray over those teams, then recalls giving that a draft is coming to America in which women as well as men are drafted, with Trump president at the time.
quote: they would use women in the draft
falsify_match: Conscription reinstated in America including women.
falsify_miss: No draft. America has had no draft since 1973 and women have never been conscripted, which makes this a strong claim.

claim_text: The draft material repeated with an appeal for viewers to confirm in the comments that they remember him giving it.
quote: Put in the comment section right now if you remember
falsify_match: The earlier recording containing the women in the draft detail.
falsify_miss: It does not. Asking the audience to confirm memory is the weaker form of the check; the corpus is the stronger one.

claim_text: Younger women called into service and sent to Europe because America itself was struck on its own soil, which he says he gave a year and a half to two years earlier and is now in the news.
quote: they were going to Europe cuz that we got struck on America soil
falsify_match: An attack on American soil followed by conscription and deployment to Europe.
falsify_miss: Neither. The sequence is specific: the strike comes first and the draft follows.

claim_text: Hospitals in trouble rather than the Red Cross, and a massive storm over Boston and the New York area so black like onyx that you cannot see through it, full of lightning like an electric storm.
quote: this storm is so black like onyx
falsify_match: A severe event centred on Boston and New York hospitals.
falsify_miss: None. The storm is his standing image for trouble rather than weather, which he applies to both cities.

claim_text: People in shamrocks and green and white jerseys celebrating basketball and then the New York Knicks seen, with instruction to watch those two teams, and he notes that they played that night and nothing happened.
quote: watch these two teams. What does that mean? I don't know
falsify_match: An incident at a game between those two teams.
falsify_miss: The game passed without incident, which he states himself and credits to God.

claim_text: Cells seen on the east coast, in the central part and on the west coast, brought in through tunnels under the ground in Arizona by the cartels for big money, with tunnels coming out in mountains and certain cities, and also through the northern border from Canada.
quote: Through the tunnels underneath the ground in Arizona
falsify_match: Discovery of tunnels used to move operatives rather than narcotics.
falsify_miss: Tunnels are found carrying drugs, which is the documented use. The operative claim is the part that would have to be shown.

claim_text: Prayer over Tuttle and the gas plants because of a retaliation coming for what is happening in Iran and Israel, with his statement that there is no ceasefire and that they will end up stirring it up again.
quote: I told you there's no ceasefire
falsify_match: A ceasefire collapsing and a retaliation striking American energy infrastructure.
falsify_miss: A ceasefire holds. He is explicit that announced ceasefires will not hold, which is checkable.

claim_text: He notes negotiators being announced and then killed within minutes and replaced repeatedly, and points to a Texas man accused of bringing a loaded gun and more than a hundred rounds into a Houston church and being tackled by security, which he says is the sympathiser he was told to watch for and credits their prayers with stopping.
quote: Watch for sympathizer
falsify_match: The earlier word naming Houston and a church attack before the arrest.
falsify_miss: He does point to having said pray over Houston, which is on the record in this corpus; whether sympathiser was attached to it is the question.

claim_text: A rebirthing of America on its 250th anniversary with the nation rededicating itself as one nation under God, like renewing marriage vows, going back to what the founders and the pilgrims intended.
quote: a rebirthing of America on our 250th anniversary
falsify_match: A national religious rededication around 4 July 2026.
falsify_miss: No such event. The anniversary is dated, which makes the window definite even though the claim is a petition.

claim_text: Prayer over the Secret Service to stay attentive and ahead of every plot, and that America will have revival again with prayer in the White House all the time, with the statement that it is not time for America to completely crumble.
quote: It's not time for America to completely crumble
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it sits against his own collapse material and is worth keeping.

claim_text: He says he hears so many people saying one more round and believes instead that something glorious will be done, with Australia, England, South Africa, Asia, Africa, Europe, the Middle East and Israel prayed for together.
quote: I hear so many people say one more round
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: A vast supply and a river that never runs dry so there is no reason for competition between ministries, with young new ministers and platforms rising while those long in the pulpits resist.
quote: There is a vast supply. Come to the river
falsify_match: A generational turnover in visible ministry leadership.
falsify_miss: No turnover. This is the same changing of the guard claim applied to his own field.

claim_text: Spiritual cannibalism named across the church, established ministers destroying the gift in younger ones out of insecurity because they see a threat to their platform, with the word that he is done with it and will remove them and put the younger in their place.
quote: THERE'S SPIRITUAL CANNIBALISM ALL ACROSS MY CHURCH
falsify_match: Established ministry figures removed and replaced by younger ones.
falsify_miss: No such replacement. The threat is stated as conditional on the behaviour continuing, which gives an exit either way.

claim_text: An offer to post a free Bible to anyone in America who gives their heart to Jesus watching the stream, with no follow-up or requests, and thirty six conversions counted that night.
quote: We will send you a Bible
falsify_match: Not applicable; an offer with a counted figure.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the nightly conversion count is one of the few numbers about the operation that is stated plainly.

claim_text: The water rising from the soles of the shoes to ankle, knee, waist and over the head, with the harvest of intercessory prayer springing forth, and it moving suddenly to Minnesota and then to Tennessee near Perry Stone's ministry.
quote: You're not big enough to mess this up
falsify_match: Revival beginning at the named places in that order.
falsify_miss: None begins. The Ezekiel 47 water imagery gives the stages, which makes progress describable at any level.

claim_text: Wells of revival springing forth in sequence from Minnesota to Tennessee to Mobile Alabama to Fort Worth to Oklahoma City to Collinsville to Tulsa and then to Nigeria, with a wave coming out of Minnesota.
quote: It went from Minnesota to Tennessee to Mobile, Alabama
falsify_match: Revival appearing in that named sequence of towns.
falsify_miss: It does not. The list is the same set of churches he has named since 2025, with Nigeria added.

claim_text: Glory zones and designated chosen places for revival, seen as the hand of the Lord with five fingers over the earth from which shafts of light shot down and became pillars, marking the places designated for a major harvest.
quote: These are the places that I have designated
falsify_match: Revival concentrated at the marked locations.
falsify_miss: None. Five fingers gives a number, which is more than the usual pillars material carries.

claim_text: The shafts of glory reaching America, Australia, Asia, the Middle East, Europe and Africa, with satanic camps trying to camp around those areas to prevent the glory, which he says are no match.
quote: I saw satanic camps trying to camp themselves around
falsify_match: Simultaneous movements at the marked places.
falsify_miss: None. Opposition being expected means slow progress is anticipated rather than counted against.

claim_text: He warns against praying the news and says what the Holy Spirit gave was that Israel would strike and would blow up all Iran's oil wells, not America, and that Israel would act alone.
quote: I said Israel will blow up all their oil wells
falsify_match: Israel acting alone against Iranian oil infrastructure.
falsify_miss: America acts, or acts jointly. He stakes the distinction explicitly and repeatedly, which makes it scoreable.

claim_text: Antisemitism at an all time high with Jews unable to go to restaurants or grocery stores without rioting, picketing and rocks thrown, of biblical proportion, a new Hitler type springing forth in Europe as in the Holocaust so bad that the Jews flee back to Israel.
quote: a new Hitler type of a anti-semitism
falsify_match: Violence against Jews in Europe at a level driving mass emigration.
falsify_miss: Incidents stay below that level. The Holocaust comparison sets the benchmark he chose.

claim_text: He says all these things are happening and points to a ceasefire item, then returns to wells of revival springing up across the land and a promise that his platform will be a place of refuge bringing fresh anointing to those without it.
quote: This will be a place of refuge to come and get a drink
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable; the platform is named as the channel of the anointing, which is worth recording.

claim_text: Attacks seen on American oil refineries and oil facilities all over the country, which he says was symbolic, with the thumbnail behind him showing what they are praying over.
quote: I saw attacks on our oil refineries and our oil facilities
falsify_match: Attacks on multiple American refineries.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself it was symbolic, which loosens what would count.

claim_text: America is not the main target, Israel is, but America is in the way and they will go for the kill shot rather than trading blows, and he repeats many many small 9/11s across the land rather than one large one.
quote: many, many, many 911s. So, a lot of them, but small
falsify_match: A series of small coordinated attacks across America.
falsify_miss: No such series. Small and many rather than one large is the shape he specifies, which is checkable in aggregate.

claim_text: The many small 9/11s repeated with prayer over Boston, and property in Oklahoma named again with people fleeing to Oklahoma and Texas away from the east in a big mass migration.
quote: you're going to see mass migration big time
falsify_match: Migration out of the eastern states at an unusual scale.
falsify_miss: Flows stay ordinary. The property angle recurs, which ties the warning to a practical instruction.

claim_text: Deals struck again with Greenland but the main focus in the days ahead being Cuba because it is too close, and he says they will see what Israel does and what Iran does to provoke.
quote: his main focus in the days ahead will be Cuba
falsify_match: American policy turning to Cuba as its principal focus.
falsify_miss: It does not. Greenland deals were already public policy discussion, which is where that half comes from.

claim_text: New York and Boston seen with the subways and mass transit and the UN.
quote: I see the subways in New York again
falsify_match: An incident on the New York subway system.
falsify_miss: None of the kind he means. Subway incidents occur regularly, so scale would be what distinguishes it.

claim_text: The subway systems in New York again with the hospitals prayed over, and the sense of people being distracted.
quote: I see subway systems like transit subways
falsify_match: As above, with hospitals involved.
falsify_miss: As above; the hospitals recur through this session.

claim_text: China seen again creating the new virus in retaliation, with instruction to pray over hospitals.
quote: In retaliation of this new virus, I see China again
falsify_match: An engineered pathogen traced to China released as retaliation.
falsify_miss: None. Retaliation gives a motive and a trigger, which is more than the earlier virus material carried.
